title: Repeated skipper consumption bound
statement: Let $r$ be a partial reader on finite bit strings and let $b$ be a natural number. Suppose every successful read from $x$ to suffix $y$ satisfies $b+|y|\le |x|$. If applying the reader $m$ times to $x$ succeeds with final suffix $y$, then $bm+|y|\le |x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a partial reader on finite bit strings
Each successful read consumes at least $b$ bits
The $m$ repeated reads from $x$ succeed with suffix $y$
